platforms._comment: Platform mode: a cloud platform serving a provider's models, authenticated with the platform's own credentials (no api_key). Keys under 'providers' are entry names you choose; an entry's provider type is its "provider" field, defaulting to the entry name. To reach a provider through Vertex AI as well as directly, add a second entry under 'providers' with another name (e.g. "claude-vertex") and "provider": "claude" -- see _example_provider_entry. Each key may appear only once in the file. 'deny' lists capabilities the deployment's policy does not allow (structured_json, web_search, json_with_search): a list for every model, or a map of model ID (or "*" for every model) to a list. Build it in code with load_ai_config().build_provider("claude-vertex"). 'locations' are what scripts/probe_platform.py checks. Keys starting with _ are notes.

vertexai._testing_comment: Optional. Read only by the live platform test tier (uv run pytest tests/ --live-platform). Every key is optional; a missing one skips the tests that need it, by name. decoy_project: an existing project the credentials have NO rights on (proves the quota project travels). claude_canary: an enabled Claude model with no quota (must answer 429). claude_5x_model: a 5.x Claude with quota (extended tier). max_cost: session cap in dollars.
